title.en: Dissolution of partnership and dissolution of a firm

heading.en: Is the business closing, or only changing?

hook.en: When one partner retires the shop stays open. When the government bans a product the firm sells, the shop must close. Both are called 'dissolution' — but they are very different.
hook.kn: ಒಬ್ಬ ಪಾಲುದಾರ ನಿವೃತ್ತನಾದರೆ ಅಂಗಡಿ ತೆರೆದೇ ಇರುತ್ತದೆ. ಸರ್ಕಾರ ಉತ್ಪನ್ನವನ್ನು ನಿಷೇಧಿಸಿದರೆ ಅಂಗಡಿ ಮುಚ್ಚಬೇಕು. ಎರಡೂ 'ವಿಸರ್ಜನೆ' — ಆದರೆ ಬಹಳ ಭಿನ್ನ.

objectives.en: Distinguish dissolution of partnership from dissolution of a firm
State the modes of dissolution under Sections 40–44

narration.en: When one partner retires the shop stays open. When the government bans a product the firm sells, the shop must close. Both are called 'dissolution' — but they are very different. Let us separate the two and learn the modes of dissolving a firm.
narration.kn: ಒಬ್ಬ ಪಾಲುದಾರ ನಿವೃತ್ತನಾದರೆ ಅಂಗಡಿ ತೆರೆದೇ ಇರುತ್ತದೆ. ಸರ್ಕಾರ ಉತ್ಪನ್ನವನ್ನು ನಿಷೇಧಿಸಿದರೆ ಅಂಗಡಿ ಮುಚ್ಚಬೇಕು. ಎರಡೂ 'ವಿಸರ್ಜನೆ' — ಆದರೆ ಬಹಳ ಭಿನ್ನ. ಎರಡನ್ನೂ ಬೇರ್ಪಡಿಸಿ, ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಯ ವಿಸರ್ಜನೆಯ ವಿಧಾನಗಳನ್ನು ಕಲಿಯೋಣ.

body.en: Dissolution of partnership is a change in the relationship among partners (admission, retirement, death, change in ratio). The firm continues and its books are not closed. Dissolution of a firm ends the relationship among all partners: the business closes, assets are sold, liabilities paid and accounts closed.
body.kn: ಪಾಲುದಾರಿಕೆಯ ವಿಸರ್ಜನೆ ಎಂದರೆ ಪಾಲುದಾರರ ಸಂಬಂಧದಲ್ಲಿ ಬದಲಾವಣೆ; ಸಂಸ್ಥೆ ಮುಂದುವರಿಯುತ್ತದೆ. ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಯ ವಿಸರ್ಜನೆ ಎಂದರೆ ಎಲ್ಲ ಪಾಲುದಾರರ ಸಂಬಂಧ ಕೊನೆಗೊಳ್ಳುವುದು; ವ್ಯಾಪಾರ ಮುಚ್ಚಿ ಖಾತೆಗಳನ್ನು ಮುಕ್ತಾಯಗೊಳಿಸಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

Dissolution of a firm ends the relationship among all partners: the business closes, assets are sold, liabilities paid and accounts closed.

title.en: Modes of dissolution of a firm

body.en: By agreement (Sec 40); compulsory, when all or all but one partner become insolvent or the business becomes illegal (Sec 41); on contingencies such as expiry of term, completion of the venture, death or insolvency of a partner (Sec 42); by notice in a partnership at will (Sec 43); by the court, for example insanity, permanent incapacity, misconduct, persistent breach of agreement, transfer of interest, continuous losses, or just and equitable grounds (Sec 44).
body.kn: ಒಪ್ಪಂದದಿಂದ (40), ಕಡ್ಡಾಯ ವಿಸರ್ಜನೆ — ದಿವಾಳಿತನ ಅಥವಾ ವ್ಯಾಪಾರ ಕಾನೂನುಬಾಹಿರ (41), ಘಟನೆಗಳ ಸಂಭವದಿಂದ — ಅವಧಿ ಮುಕ್ತಾಯ, ಮರಣ (42), ಸೂಚನೆಯಿಂದ (43), ನ್ಯಾಯಾಲಯದಿಂದ — ಮಾನಸಿಕ ಅಸ್ವಸ್ಥತೆ, ದುರ್ನಡತೆ, ನಿರಂತರ ನಷ್ಟ (44).

problem.en: Identify the mode of dissolution: (a) the State bans the sale of the firm's only product; (b) a partnership formed for five years completes its term; (c) one partner becomes of unsound mind and another partner files a suit.

steps.en: (a) The business has become illegal: compulsory dissolution, Section 41.
(b) Expiry of the fixed term: dissolution on a contingency, Section 42.
(c) Insanity of a partner on a suit: dissolution by the court, Section 44.

narration.en: Let us work this out together, step by step. Identify the mode of dissolution: (a) the State bans the sale of the firm's only product; (b) a partnership formed for five years completes its term; (c) one partner becomes of unsound mind and another partner files a suit.
40 to 44 in order. Agreement, Compulsory, Contingency, Notice, Court — 40, 41, 42, 43, 44.
Class quiz. Discuss, raise hands, and the monitor taps the class answer.
narration.kn: ತರಗತಿ ರಸಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ. ಚರ್ಚಿಸಿ, ಕೈ ಎತ್ತಿ, ಮಾನಿಟರ್ ತರಗತಿಯ ಉತ್ತರವನ್ನು ಒತ್ತಲಿ.

points.en: Dissolution of partnership changes the relationship; the firm continues.
Dissolution of a firm closes the business and the books.
points.kn: ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಯ ವಿಸರ್ಜನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ವ್ಯಾಪಾರ ಮತ್ತು ಪುಸ್ತಕಗಳು ಮುಚ್ಚುತ್ತವೆ.

points.en: Modes: agreement, compulsory, contingency, notice and court (Sections 40–44).
points.kn: ವಿಧಾನಗಳು: ಒಪ್ಪಂದ, ಕಡ್ಡಾಯ, ಘಟನೆ, ಸೂಚನೆ, ನ್ಯಾಯಾಲಯ (40–44).
